45. I would receive instructions from Mr. Cheung of PC&E, either by telephone call or WhatsApp message, to extend the suspension period as PC&E required more time for renovation works to the fire services water tanks. I would then submit on behalf of China Status to the FSD applications, each time for extensions of 14 days further, for the buildings concerned.

46. Neither myself nor China Status were ever informed that works to any of the fire water tanks had been completed, so no FS251 notice was ever submitted to the FSD with regards to the lifting of suspensions.

47. Outside of those at Annexure 3, all other records relating to the extension applications have been seized by the police.

Question 13

48. I did not carry out any inspection at Wang Fuk Court during the period the FH / HR System was shut down. It is my understanding that no personnel of China Status did so during this period.

Questions 14 to 22

49. Neither myself nor China Status was approached for or involved in the disabling of fire alarm systems in Wang Fuk Court, and as such I do not have any answers to questions on this aspect.

This statement is true to the best of my knowledge and belief.
